body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News>

COOLIT systems has presented its new USB beverage chiller at CES 2006. This ''cool'' USB beverage chiller keeps your drink cold as long as you have it. It is simple to use by plugging into any USB port. The cold plate chills to 45F. It works with your pc, Mac, Xbox 360 or PS2.

Wouldn'' it be cool to have a cold drink for work or at play? You can also use this item for promotion purpose by putting your company name or brand to the center of cold plate. COOLIT will help you to do that.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliyah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
